summary: Full E2E validation of new batch: floating CTA, programs bootcamp+pace+coming-soon cards, apply page two-form switcher, full-stack submit with city+pace, bootcamp submit, 1:1 call modal, admin CMS new columns + CSV. Backend pytest 5/5 pass. Frontend flows all pass. One content bug found: home page marquee still contains 'Founding Cohort Now Open' 3× (should be replaced per new wording rule).

ui_bugs.issue: Contains 'Founding Cohort Now Open' 3× — requirement says all 'Founding Cohort' wording should be replaced with 'Admissions Now Open / first batch'. Home eyebrow already says 'Admissions Now Open' but marquee strip (lines 66-68 /app/frontend/public/home/index.html) still has the old copy.

action_items: Replace 'Founding Cohort Now Open' with 'Admissions Now Open' (or similar new wording) in /app/frontend/public/home/index.html lines 66, 67, 68 (marquee spans). After change, run 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' since it's a static file.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend ApplicationIn defaults form_type='fullstack' and city='' — accepts missing city silently even though frontend marks required. Consider requiring city in the model, or at least not defaulting form_type (frontend always sends it).
Call modal date input min is set to today from JS — good, but no server-side date validation on WorkshopBookingIn.date field.
OWNER_EMAILS iteration issues send_email failures silently (returns None) — emails_sent count masks partial failures; acceptable for MVP.
